description: How many National Weather Service warnings, watches and advisories have covered Crosby, TX, by type and year, computed from the site's record: tornado, severe thunderstorm, flash flood and flood warnings whose polygon contained Crosby (counted from 2007-10-01, when polygons became the official warned area), products for forecast zone TXZ213 (tropical, winter, heat, fire weather, fog; the zone has been redrawn), and Harris County watches. Includes the date of every tornado warning. For active alerts use get_alerts.
name: get_warning_history

items.description: One row per Central-time year: year plus a count per totals key.

title: NWS warning history for Crosby
